fields.quote: we compare against a number of external decoder-only transformer language models and unless otherwise stated we use the numbers published in the reports of the corresponding models
fields.reason: The stated policy is to use numbers published in other models' reports. The visible exceptions (Table 3 asterisks read from Gemma Team 2024; Mistral BBH read from Jiang et al. 2023; Table 5 GSM8K/MBPP taken from Gemma Team 2024) are still copied from other reports, not recomputed by the authors, so this is YES rather than MIXED.
